$schema_note: Pre-submission and pre-presentation checklists. Two families: engineering/technical readiness (from the blueprint's §1.5) and team/presentation readiness (from the mentor playbook's Non-Tech readiness checklists). Check items off as completed -- do not mark 'complete' items that are still open in warnings.json.

checklists.title: Minimum Credible Bar (must-have)
checklists.description: The floor requirement to be taken seriously at all -- per the blueprint, judges will probe these first.

items.item: Cruise power correctly computed at 250 km/h, stated altitude, with cited equations
NSGA-II converges and produces a genuine, interpretable Pareto front (not a degenerate line)
items.evidence: report Figure 1-2, hypervolume_convergence.png shows real convergence

items.item: RL power-split benchmarked against two baselines with quantified improvement
items.evidence: Benchmarked (Table 3), but RL is currently the rule-based fallback, not a trained policy -- see warnings.json :: rl_controller_not_trained

items.item: Validation table filled with real numbers, not placeholders
Dashboard runs end-to-end without crashing
items.evidence: Dashboard is currently only specified (dashboard/*.json configs), not implemented as running Streamlit code

items.item: All assumptions cited (not guessed)
items.evidence: Most are cited (physics.py, aircraft.py docstrings); structural_weight_fraction inconsistency and L/D=16 vs drag-polar mismatch remain open -- see warnings.json

checklists.title: Differentiating Bar (shortlist vs. winner)
checklists.description: What separates a shortlisted project from a winning one, per the blueprint.

items.item: Sensitivity analysis on key parameters (BSFC, battery Wh/kg, L/D)
Hypervolume convergence plot demonstrating NSGA-II is not terminating early
SoC trajectory showing correct climb-deficit and descent-recovery behaviour
items.evidence: SoC trajectory exists (soc_trajectory.png) but descent-recovery energy is unquantified -- warnings.json :: descent_regeneration_unquantified

items.item: Power-balance plot showing engine + battery + required power across all mission phases
items.evidence: Specified in dashboard/charts.json :: power_balance, not yet generated as a standalone report figure

items.item: Explicit, quantified treatment of the 250 km/h cruise power gap

checklists.title: Judge Q&A Readiness (5 questions, in order judges are expected to ask)

items.item: "You claim 7.7 hours endurance. How did you compute that?" -- answer must reference the numerical mission-sim integration, not the Breguet formula
"Your engine is 60 kW. At 250 km/h, what is your cruise power requirement?" -- must know the answer is tight
"Show me your Pareto front. What does each axis represent? Why those objectives?"
"How does your RL controller behave during climb when the battery is low?"
items.notes: Requires an edge-case-specific trajectory plot/answer, not just the nominal benchmark numbers -- not yet prepared

items.item: "If I give you a different mission profile -- say, longer loiter -- can your tool handle it?" -- this is the 'is it a tool or a demo' question; the answer must be yes, ideally demonstrated live (change a parameter, rerun, show a new Pareto front)
items.notes: Requires the dashboard's 'Run Optimization' button to actually work end-to-end on a live parameter change, not just replay a cached result -- see dashboard/sidebar.json :: run_optimization_button
